text: **dsh-find-plugin**（DSH 网页客户端插件）：帮助用户按需求查找 DSH 插件。它注册 `find_dsh_plugin` 工具，在 GitHub 的 `dsh-plugin` 主题中实时搜索仓库并按 star 排序，再用精选目录中的双语描述补充结果；GitHub 受限或不可达时，会改用本地目录做关键词匹配。结果包含简介、仓库链接和安装命令，适合想发现现成插件的用户。`GITHUB_TOKEN` 是可选配置，不配置也能匿名搜索。

dsh-find-plugin registers `find_dsh_plugin` to search GitHub's `dsh-plugin` topic, rank results by stars, and add curated bilingual descriptions. If GitHub is unavailable, it searches the curated catalog by keywords. Results include links and install commands. `GITHUB_TOKEN` is optional.
想按我描述的需求找一个现成的 DSH 插件
DSH 里有哪些能发微信通知或管理记忆的扩展？
帮我搜索社区里提供某项功能的 DSH 插件并比较热度
我想知道一个需求有没有对应的 DSH 插件以及怎么安装
GitHub 搜索限流时还能从精选插件目录里找到相关工具吗
按中文简介查找 DSH 插件，并显示可直接使用的添加命令
Find DSH plugins on GitHub that match a capability I describe.
Show me popular community plugins and their install commands.
Search the curated DSH plugin catalog when GitHub search is unavailable.
dsh-find-plugin 的功能「按需求搜索插件」：调用 `find_dsh_plugin` 并输入描述能力的关键词；工具搜索 GitHub 的 `dsh-plugin` 主题，返回仓库名称、简介、star 数和安装命令。
dsh-find-plugin 的功能「按热度展示结果」：实时搜索结果会按 star 数从高到低排列；每次最多请求 20 条候选，并按用户指定的数量截取返回。
dsh-find-plugin 的功能「精选描述与语言选择」：命中精选目录的仓库会显示该目录的双语简介；用户可用 `lang` 选择语言，其他结果保留 GitHub 简介。
dsh-find-plugin 的功能「限流时搜索精选目录」：GitHub 搜索遇到限流或网络故障时，工具会按名称、类别和简介匹配精选目录，并在结果说明中标明回退来源。
dsh-find-plugin 的功能「缓存精选目录供离线回退」：目录数据会在内存和 DSH_HOME 下缓存并用 ETag 条件请求更新；网络不可用时按磁盘缓存、内存或内置快照顺序读取。
dsh-find-plugin 使用时会把搜索词发送到 api.github.com 的仓库搜索接口；`GITHUB_TOKEN` 是可选的 DSH credential，不设置时仍以匿名方式请求。
dsh-find-plugin 从 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 获取精选目录，并缓存到 `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-find-plugin/registry.json`；未设置时默认目录为 `~/.dsh`。

dsh-find-plugin 提供工具 find_dsh_plugin：Search GitHub for DeepSeek Harness plugins (public `dsh-plugin` topic), ranked by stars. Returns descriptions and ready-to-run `dsh plugin add` install commands. Use when the user wants a capability DSH does not currently have, or asks what plugins exist. Plugins are third-party code — advise reviewing the source and pinning a commit. Falls back to keyword matches from the curated awesome-dsh-plugin list when GitHub search is rate limited or unreachable; the note states which source was used.

dsh-find-plugin README · dsh-find-plugin [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)：English | [中文](README.zh.md) **A plugin that finds plugins** — think [`/find-skills`](https://skills.sh) from skills.sh, for DSH. Tell your agent what you want ("notify me on WeChat when a task finishes"), and it searches the DSH plugin ecosystem on GitHub for you — top results by stars, each with a one-line description and an install command.
dsh-find-plugin README · Install：```sh
dsh-find-plugin README · from npm (prebuilt, recommended)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-find-plugin

dsh-find-plugin README · or from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:awesome-dsh-plugin/dsh-find-plugin
```

dsh-find-plugin README · Usage：Restart `dsh web` after installing, then just talk to the agent — it calls
`find_dsh_plugin` on its own whenever plugin discovery helps:

- "What terminal TUI plugins are there?"
- "I want to get a WeChat notification when a task finishes — any plugin for that?"
- "Find me something for reviewing git diffs inside DSH."

Each result comes back with stars, a description, the repo link, and a
ready-to-run `dsh plugin add` command — ask the agent to install one and
it can run the command for you.

dsh-find-plugin README · How it works：- Live GitHub repository search scoped to the official `dsh-plugin` topic,
  re-ranked by stars (5-minute per-query cache).
- When a result is also listed on
  [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com), its hand-written
  bilingual description from `plugins.json` replaces the GitHub one (the
  `lang` parameter picks the language) — ranking is untouched.
- Every result comes with a ready-to-run `dsh plugin add` command. Plugins
  are third-party code — review the source and pin a commit.

dsh-find-plugin README · Rate limits and offline fallback：GitHub's **search** API allows only 10 requests/minute per public IP when
unauthenticated, and that quota is shared by every host behind the same egress
IP (carrier CGNAT, corporate NAT, …), so a search can fail with `HTTP 403` for
reasons outside your control. The plugin therefore:

dsh-find-plugin README · Rate limits and offline fallback：- uses the **`GITHUB_TOKEN` DSH credential** when one is configured (30
  req/min, account-scoped, immune to shared-IP exhaustion). Optional — without
  it the tool still works, just closer to the anonymous limit;
- retries a rate-limited (403/429) or failed request once, then degrades
  instead of failing: it falls back to **keyword matches from the curated
  list** and says so in the result note;
- caches the curated list on disk (`$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-find-plugin/`) and
  revalidates it with `If-None-Match` / `If-Modified-Since`, so restarts and
  offline runs use the full ~3400-entry list instead of the small bundled
  snapshot.
- says *why* a request failed. Node reports every transport failure as a bare
  `fetch failed` and hides the useful part in `cause`, so the plugin surfaces
  the chain (`fetch failed ← certificate has expired (CERT_HAS_EXPIRED)`) and
  names the one trap that otherwise looks like a plugin bug: a system proxy or
  VPN accelerator, which Node's `fetch` ignores unless DSH itself was started
  with `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` (or `--use-env-proxy`). A browser has no such
  rule — which is why GitHub opens

dsh-find-plugin README · Compatibility：DSH plugin APIs are prerelease-versioned, and node-semver only lets a
prerelease satisfy a range that carries a prerelease on the *same*
major.minor.patch — so a peer range pinned to one host line silently stops
matching the next one. The declared `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` range therefore
names every shipped line through `0.1.7`, and `npm run check:peers` (run in CI)
resolves the current `latest`/`next` host lines from the registry and fails the
day a new one is not covered.

dsh-find-plugin README · Development：```sh
npm run typecheck                     # tsc --noEmit
npm test                              # offline tests (mocked fetch)
FINDP_LIVE=1 npm run test:live        # opt-in real-network cases
```
